text: I find myself in a liminal space, shifting from the utilitarian precision of a meeting room to the vibrant energy of an exhibition area dedicated to research and development. In the first space, with its glass walls and formal arrangement, I feel somewhat detached, an observer on the threshold, curious but slightly tense—perhaps awaiting the start of a collective endeavor. In the second space, the bold colors and engaging displays awaken my intellectual curiosity and a sense of possibility. Here, inquiry, creativity, and the urge to understand technology's evolution stir a quiet excitement within me. Above all, I sense the continuous interplay of contemplation and invention.
